remarks: Spectacular new primary bath and full house refresh. Light-filled center hall colonial set on a quiet cul-de-sac, walking distance to water and Tokeneke School. The two-story foyer leads into generous dining and living rooms with French doors to front porch. The heart of the home is the gourmet kitchen with spacious dining area open to the family room with soaring ceiling and stone fireplace. French doors lead out to a large deck perfect for entertaining. Butler's pantry with second dishwasher, wine refrigerator and walk-in pantry. A spacious, private office/den, laundry room and 1.5 baths complete the first floor. 5 bedrooms and 3 full baths upstairs. The Primary bedroom boasts two walk-in closets and a gracious en-suite bathroom. Finished lower level with mudroom and lots of storage.
